title.zh: EU banking watchdog calls for crypto lending rules under MiCA
title.en: EU banking watchdog calls for crypto lending rules under MiCA

current_state.zh: The European Banking Authority recommended that the European Commission extend MiCA to cover crypto borrowing and lending, including crypto firms intermediating access to DeFi lending protocols, and conduct a cost-benefit analysis of adding such services to the regulated list with new compliance and oversight requirements.
current_state.en: The European Banking Authority recommended that the European Commission extend MiCA to cover crypto borrowing and lending, including crypto firms intermediating access to DeFi lending protocols, and conduct a cost-benefit analysis of adding such services to the regulated list with new compliance and oversight requirements.
